{{Quote|My people will never submit to the rule of the Emperor's craven bureaucrats.''"<br />"''Yeah? Well, when the Imperials are finished with your lovely little planet, it's gonna smell like something outta the ''Dorion Discus's'' autokitchen.|A [[Sessehshellah]] and a crewmember of the ''[[Dorion Discus]]''|<ref name="RoBW">{{WEGCite|story=Rings of Bright Water|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>}}
An '''autochef''',<ref name="RPG" /> also known as an '''autokitchen'''<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> or '''autogalley''',<ref name="SOTESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> was an automated [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]-preparation tool. It could be programmed to create simple meals from a limited selection of food. Autochefs were generally used aboard smaller [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to prepare meals for the crew and passengers.<ref name="RPG" />
